title: The Shame of Broken Realm
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji's faint, almost imperceptible smile made Lin Xiao's heart tremble inexplicably—how could this waste have anything to smile about?

text.content: When the morning bell tolled for the third time, the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena was already packed with people. The Sect Competition was held once every five years, and today was the first day of preliminary rounds. Sunlight fell upon the blue stone ground, stretching the shadows of ten thousand disciples into long silhouettes. On the podium, the elders sat like pines, their postures serene. Among them, Ling Yuan's gaze swept casually across a certain spot in the crowd, a meaningful smile curving his lips.

dialogue.content: Look, isn't that waste Chen Ji? He actually dares to participate in the competition? Really doesn't know his own worth!

text.content: Han Lie's laughter was particularly shrill, drawing the attention of surrounding disciples. Chen Ji stood at the very edge of the crowd, his faded gray robe standing out starkly among the splendid garments around him. He kept his head bowed, his expression unreadable, only his fingers hidden within his sleeve moving faintly—as if calculating something. No one noticed the Turtle Shell Fragment hidden in his chest emitting a faint, eerie glow.

dialogue.content: (Inner) Lin Xiao, Foundation Building late stage. Three years ago, he broke my fingers in front of a hundred people, saying this is the consequence of wastes not being fit for cultivation. Three years have passed—he probably forgot who I am long ago... Good.

text.content: The Law Enforcement Elder unfurled the roster, his sonorous voice echoing across the entire arena: "Preliminary round one, third match—Outer Disciple/Servant Chen Ji versus Inner Disciple Lin Xiao!" The moment the words fell, the crowd erupted. Some sneered, some shook their heads, and others began placing bets on how many moves it would take for Chen Ji to fall. Lin Xiao pushed through the crowd, his white robes spotless as snow, a playful smile adorning his face:

dialogue.content: Oh, isn't this Brother Chen? Three years不见, still this miserable appearance. What, want to turn things around at the competition? Unfortunately, waste is waste—standing on this platform changes nothing.

text.content: Lin Xiao's voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. He even stretched out a finger, waving it before Chen Ji: "When I broke your fingers back then, you didn't even dare scream. Want to try it again today? After all, no one will stand up for you." Laughter erupted from the surroundings. Chen Ji still kept his head lowered, his shoulders trembling faintly—whether from fear or suppressed laughter.

Just then, commotion arose from the direction of the podium. Inner Disciple Senior Fellow Su Qingyao had somehow appeared at the edge of the crowd. Her gaze pierced through the layers of people, falling upon Chen Ji. For three years, she had been secretly observing this "waste." Her intuition told her things were far from what they seemed. But now, she could only watch as Chen Ji was pushed to the center of attention.

Chen Ji slowly raised his head. His expression was very calm—calm to the point of being eerie. Those eyes were like ancient wells, bottomless and unfathomable, showing no anger or fear whatsoever. When Lin Xiao met his gaze, he inexplicably felt a chill. But the next second, he cast aside this feeling—a waste is just a waste. What could possibly happen?

dialogue.content: Brother Lin is right. A waste shouldn't participate in the competition. So for three years, I haven't even broken through Foundation Building. I should face reality.

text.content: Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet it cut through the noisy arena with unusual clarity. Lin Xiao froze, then burst into hearty laughter: "At least you know your place! Here's the deal—kneel down and kowtow three times, call me grandpa, and I'll go easy on you—only break one hand. How about it?" At these words, even some elders frowned. This was too much.

Chen Ji didn't speak. His right hand quietly slipped into his chest, fingers touching the warm Turtle Shell Fragment. A faint power surged into his mind, and the scene before his eyes began to blur—three breaths later, he saw Lin Xiao's weakness: old injury on his right knee. How convenient—three years ago, he used that right leg to kick and break his fingers.

dialogue.content: (Inner) Three years. Heavenly Fate value is only 45 points now. Every premonition must be considered carefully. But today... it's worth it. Heavenly Fate -5. Since I'm going to use it, I might as well make it beautiful.

choice.prompt: Lin Xiao publicly humiliated Chen Ji, demanding he kneel and kowtow. You choose:

choices.description: Continue playing the part of a waste, wait for Lin Xiao to lower his guard, then strike for the victory. Low risk, but may seem too cowardly.
choices.visible_reward: Lin Xiao completely underestimates you, exposing his weakness
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, there will be no way out

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly knelt down. The moment his knees touched the ground, silence reigned for a single breath—then erupted into earth-shaking mockery. "Hahaha! He actually has the face to kneel!" Lin Xiao laughed triumphantly, tilting his head back: "Waste is waste—even has no dignity!" Chen Ji kept his head lowered, voice trembling: "Brother Lin, I admit defeat..." The Law Enforcement Elder was about to announce the result when Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, his eyes flashing with sharp light.

choices.description: Counterattack with sharp words, neither servile nor overbearing, putting Lin Xiao on the spot. Medium risk, obvious satisfaction.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke Lin Xiao, suffer harsher revenge
choices.visible_reward: Redeem some dignity, earn partial respect from others
choices.risk_hint: If out-argued, will be even more humiliating

text.content: Chen Ji slowly straightened up, his gaze meeting Lin Xiao's calmly: "Brother Lin is right—a waste shouldn't participate in the competition. So—" He paused, a mocking arc curling at the corner of his lips: "What does that make the 'genius' who was tricked into the Forbidden Grounds by a waste three years ago and almost lost his life?" Lin Xiao's face changed drastically—that was his greatest shame, never before mentioned by anyone. "What did you say?!"

choices.description: Cooperate on the surface, but use the premonition ability to set up a trap, humiliating Lin Xiao in front of everyone. Highest risk, greatest reward.
choices.visible_reward: Lin Xiao's reputation ruined, completely humiliated
choices.risk_hint: If failed, will expose the existence of the Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flashed with sharp light, the Turtle Shell Fragment warming in his chest. He had already calculated everything that would happen in the next ten breaths. "Brother Lin," he suddenly spoke, voice not loud but crystal clear, "you said wastes aren't fit for cultivation. So what if—the waste wins?" Lin Xiao froze, then laughed so hard he nearly doubled over: "Wins? You? Dream on!" Chen Ji said nothing more, only slowly raising his right hand, extending one finger.

One finger. Lin Xiao laughed despite his fury: "Bold! A waste who hasn't even broken through Foundation Building, dare to be so arrogant!" He struck with his palm, the掌风凌厉, carrying the full might of Foundation Building late stage,直奔陈机面门。人群发出惊呼——这一掌，足以要了普通外门弟子的命！Chen Ji remained motionless.

dialogue.content: (Inner) Three breaths later, his right leg will weaken. Nine breaths later, his center of gravity will shift left. Twelve breaths later, his old injury will flare up and expose his weakness. That's enough.

choice.prompt: Lin Xiao goes all out. You decide how to respond:

choices.description: Trade injury for injury, use your body to absorb the blow in exchange for close combat opportunity. Simple and brutal, but will take damage.
choices.visible_cost: Sustain internal injury, combat power temporarily decreased
choices.visible_reward: Instantly close the distance, seize the initiative
choices.risk_hint: If opponent's strength overwhelms, may suffer severe injury

text.content: Chen Ji neither dodged nor evaded, letting that palm strike his chest. A muffled "boom" sounded. A trace of blood溢出口角，但身体却纹丝不动！Lin Xiao's pupils contracted sharply—this was wrong! How could an Outer Disciple/Servant possibly use his flesh to block such a palm? In that moment of distraction, Chen Ji had already surged forward, his left hand like a venomous snake darting toward his right knee!

choices.description: Use premonition to precisely evade, strike the moment opponent's old injury flares. Low risk, high success rate.
choices.visible_reward: Perfect dodge + precise strike, one move to defeat enemy

text.content: The instant before the palm wind reached his body, Chen Ji's form suddenly swayed, ghostlike, moving three inches to the left. "What?!" Lin Xiao's palm struck empty air, pupils constricting. He wanted to收回招式，却感觉右腿一阵剧痛——旧伤提前发作了！就在这一瞬间，Chen Ji's fingers had already pressed against his right knee. A crisp "snap" echoed as Lin Xiao screamed, his knee twisting grotesquely.

choices.description: Deliberately expose weakness, lure Lin Xiao deeper, then counter-kill with one strike. Greatest reward, but requires acting skills.
choices.visible_reward: Lin Xiao completely exposes all weaknesses, one strike to kill
choices.risk_hint: If opponent doesn't pursue, may miss the opportunity

text.content: Chen Ji let out an "ah" scream, his body flying backward, rolling twice after hitting the ground, looking on the verge of death. "Hahaha! Waste is waste!" Lin Xiao laughed heartily, striding forward to finish him off. However, he failed to notice that the spot where Chen Ji fell happened to be the direction of weakness for his right leg's support. When Lin Xiao kicked toward Chen Ji's abdomen, Chen Ji suddenly exploded upward, striking back with a sword that pierced through his right leg!

Lin Xiao knelt on the ground, blood pouring from his right leg. He stared at this "waste" in disbelief, lips trembling: "You... you cheated! You must have hidden your cultivation!" The entire arena fell silent. Everyone was shocked by what they witnessed. Three years—this waste who didn't even dare make a sound when his fingers were broken had, at the Sect Competition, crippled an Inner Sect genius's leg in one move!

dialogue.content: Chen Ji squatted down, bringing himself eye to eye with Lin Xiao. His expression remained calm, yet his voice carried only to those two: "Brother Lin, when you broke my fingers three years ago, did you ever imagine today?" Lin Xiao trembled all over, eyes filled with fear and不甘. Chen Ji stood up, looking down at him: "A waste just hasn't reached the time to counterattack yet."

text.content: The Law Enforcement Elder's voice announcing the result trembled slightly: "Third match... Outer Disciple/Servant Chen Ji, victorious!" The Martial Arena exploded. Mockery turned to exclamations, exclamations to whispers. Su Qingyao's pupils contracted slightly. She finally confirmed her suspicion—this Chen Ji was absolutely no ordinary person. In the distance, Han Lie's expression was grimly dark. The waste won? He would not allow this to happen.

Chen Ji slowly descended the Arena Platform, footsteps steady, as if everything just now was merely a trivial warm-up. His gaze swept across the crowd, lingering on Han Lie for a moment. That instant of eye contact sent an inexplicable chill down Han Lie's spine. This waste... that gaze just now, why was it even colder than when he looked at Lin Xiao? Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, lips curving slightly upward. The next match... it should be Han Lie's turn, shouldn't it?
